name: open_gripper
description: Propose an open command while holding the measured current grip-site pose. Use when: current evidence supports jaw opening; use move_pose for a pose change. Effect: submits one observation-bound gripper-only action v3 proposal to the Supervisor and ends this turn. Returns: submitted status and open_gripper action immediately; the later receipt and fresh observation show measured motion and opening. Does not: establish release at a correct place, invariant measured pose or task success. On error: wait for a pending action to finish and inspect fresh evidence before changing the plan.
